wrangler.toml:
name = "uploads-bare"
main = "src/index.js"
compatibility_date = "2024-01-01"

[[r2_buckets]]
binding = "UPLOADS"
bucket_name = "uploads-bare"

[ai]
binding = "AI"

# Set the shared upload API key with:
#   wrangler secret put API_KEY
README.md:
# uploads-bare

A small upload service built as a Cloudflare Worker.

## Endpoints

- `PUT /files/:name` — stores the request body in R2 and returns a one-sentence
  AI-generated description. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`.
- `GET /files/:name` — returns the stored file, with the description in the
  `X-File-Description` response header.

## Setup

```
wrangler r2 bucket create uploads-bare
wrangler secret put API_KEY
wrangler deploy
```
